params.comment: Starter for a repo that serves a site. Replace OWNER and my-repo with yours. origin is the production URL. For a built site folder instead, set site_dir (for example dist, which needs an index.html) and origin to an empty string. No site: delete this file and drop pages from quality/config.json. The design tab reads the site from this entry.
The usability tab reads the site from this entry: keep origin and site_dir the same as design.raw_hex.
platform pages reads GitHub Pages deploys through the GitHub API. For a Cloudflare Worker, delete this entry and log in to Wrangler (wrangler-login).
